_comment: A planing hull's spray mist: soft lit puffs (textures/particles/spray_mist.png, 2x2) that hang and drift on the wind. vfx/VesselSpray drives position, segment, direction, speeds and rate every frame, and the albedo (the colour keys' rgb) and forwardScatter from the ocean preset's spray knobs (OceanRenderConfig::sprayColor, sprayForwardScatter).
